aztec-nr - noir_aztec::facts

Module facts

Per-contract storage of immutable facts grouped into collections.

A fact is a contract-defined, typed, immutable datum. Facts are grouped into collections identified by a (collection type, collection id) tuple.

They are stored in PXE's FactStore, which automatically deals with reorgs by removing any facts associated with blocks that have been pruned.

Structs

  • Fact
    A single immutable fact in a collection.
  • FactCollection
    A fact collection as returned by the store.
  • OriginBlock
    The block a retractable fact originates from.
  • OriginBlockState
    Chain state of a retractable fact's origin block, mirroring the L2 chain tips.
  • RetractableFactOrigin
    A retractable fact's origin block.

Functions

  • delete_fact_collection
    Deletes a fact collection, removing all its facts from PXE storage.
  • get_fact_collection
    Fetches a fact collection.
  • get_fact_collections_by_type
    Returns every fact collection of fact_collection_type_id.
  • record_non_retractable_fact
    Records a non-retractable fact into a collection: it survives reorgs and will persist until the fact collection itself is deleted. Re-recording an identical fact is a no-op.
  • record_retractable_fact
    Records a retractable fact into a collection: PXE prunes it if origin_block is reorg'd away. Re-recording an identical fact is a no-op.
